Tea Time
~1:15 PM: So I brewed some orange-clove-flavored black tea. Now,
black tea is the most caffeinated type of tea, so I was getting a good dose of Caffeine when I drank this (Tea leaves hold caffeine, which is a common stimulant drug).
1:22 PM: I admire the aroma of my tea, and begin to drink it. It tastes quite good.
1:23 PM: I'm getting a feeling of relaxation.
1:25 PM: I feel more energetic, my lungs and throat feel clear. I am also feeling relaxed and concentrated.
1:32 PM: I'm feeling awake, and ready to move around. I have a motivation to do things.
So I hope you enjoyed my report :)
